resources.string: Lets Alex tap, type, scroll and control apps by voice command.

MEDIA CONTROL
 • Play / pause / next / previous / stop media
 • Volume up, down, mute, max
 • Open gallery, camera, video recorder
 • Zoom in / out on photos (pinch gesture)
 • Play music by song or artist
 • YouTube: search, play first result, open categories
 
 APPS
 • Open any app, close app, back, home, recents
 • Tap / long-press anything by its text
 • Type, clear, copy, paste, select all
 • Scroll and swipe in any direction, tap, double tap
 • Install and uninstall apps
 
 CHAT (WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Instagram…)
 • Open any chat by contact name
 • Write text, edit text, send
 • Voice call and video call
 • Send SMS, make phone calls
 
 SYSTEM
 • Notifications, quick settings, screenshot, lock screen, power menu
 • Flashlight, Wi-Fi panel, Bluetooth panel, any Settings page
 • Alarm, timer, share text, web search, open links
 • Read the screen aloud, time, battery
 
 Say “Hey Alex” or “Alex start”, then your command.
 Example: “Hey Alex, open WhatsApp and message Rahim hello”
